description: This file defines the 'Reviewer' entity class for the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It models a reviewer, including properties like status, comments, related ratings, group, review, and employee, along with their getters and setters. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes a trait and associated classes for behavior extension.

classes.name: Reviewer
classes.description: Entity class representing a reviewer in the OrangeHRM performance module, with properties for status, comments, ratings, associated group, review, and employee, using Doctrine ORM for database persistence.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reviewer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the reviewer.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the reviewer.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the reviewer.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: setCompletedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment made by the reviewer.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment made by the reviewer.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the reviewer group associated with this reviewer.

methods.name: setGroup
methods.description: Sets the reviewer group for this reviewer.

methods.name: getReview
methods.description: Returns the performance review associated with this reviewer.

methods.name: setReview
methods.description: Sets the performance review associated with this reviewer.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee who is being reviewed.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee who is being reviewed.
